title: cffr: Generate Citation File Format Metadata for R Packages
text: Citation File Format project (Druskat et al. 2021) defines standardized format providing citation metadata software datasets plain text files easy humans machines read. GitHub uses Citation File Format built-citation support (GitHub 2021). Zenodo Zotero also support CITATION.cff files (Druskat 2021). cffr provides utilities generate validate CITATION.cff files R (R Core Team 2026) packages parsing DESCRIPTION file optional inst/CITATION file. package also includes utilities examples parsing components person reference metadata, plus vignettes illustrate basic package usage technical details metadata extraction process.

title: cffr: Generate Citation File Format Metadata for R Packages
text: Research software often omitted citations (Salmon et al. 2021). One reason software cited lack clear citation information package developers. main reasons citing software used research : Reproducibility: Software versions important information include research project. help peers understand reproduce results study effectively. Including versions also crucial recording context manuscript software changes. Developer credit: context free open source software (FOSS), many software developers also researchers. Receiving credit software development different credit received formats, books articles. CITATION.cff files provide clear citation rules software. format human-readable can also parsed appropriate software. GitHub’s adoption format sends strong message research software worthy citation therefore deserves credit. cffr allows R package developers create CITATION.cff files metadata already included package. also includes validation tools jsonvalidate package (FitzJohn et al. 2025), allows developers assess validity file Citation File Format schema.
